set.acceptance: Testscripts with a fake systemctl and a fake Rex: with the unit installed, start calls systemctl --user start and stop calls systemctl --user stop, and daemon status --json reports mode service; with none, start opens a rex window named 'rhiza daemon' running rhiza daemon, stop ends that daemon, and status reports mode tab
set.statement: rhiza daemon start and rhiza daemon stop start or stop this repo's daemon the way its installation runs it: through the systemd unit when rhiza daemon install wrote one, else in the Rex tab 'rhiza daemon' in the repo's session, and daemon status says which mode runs
